reviews.text: Heaven Sent recently completed our roof, gutters, fence and window screens and I cannot recommend them enough. A+ craftsmanship on each service. I actually used them for roof repairs over the past several years, and will now look to them for other contracting work as they have always been honest and fair in every interaction. Bryan is meticulous about his crews work, and went over & above on our project painting house areas and repairing the fence. He knew we had a pool party for my son's baseba

Bryan and his team have been incredible to work with. He guided us through the insurance process, got us the most for our money and did a fantastic job on our new roof. We have worked with them a couple times now over the years and I recommend them 100%. They are an honest company and give contractors a good name!

Excellent customer service. They had accidentally nicked our AC line while patching our roof. We called Brian up and he resolved the matter sending someone out to fix the issue the next day. Very rare to deal with a company that operates this efficiently. I would definitely recommend them as it says a lot about their mission statement.

Brian and the crew replaced my roof, and an awning on my back patio. We have enjoyed the roof. I gave an expectation for the patio awning - I wanted to be able to be on the porch with my grandson when it rained (unless it's lightning). Mission accomplished!  Not only that, but one of my sons proposed to my daughter-in-love underneath that awning. The workers were timely, friendly and conscientious.

Bryan was AMAZING! I didn't know anything about roofs and he took time to explain me everything. During the insurance inspection, he communicated with the inspector and made sure that the insurance company treated us fairly. The roof and gutter installation was quick and smooth. We found not a single nail left on the ground :) I would highly recommend Bryan and his firm. They are top-notch !

We had a new roof installed several years ago, and some repair work more recently.
We wanted an inspection following the last storm to see if we needed work or replacement to protect the value of our house.
The Heaven Sent Guys called to verify our appointment and arrived within the estimated service window.  After careful inspection they told me “The condition of your shingles are where we would expect them to be due to their age.  Normal wear and tear, nothing concerning.  I wouldn’t replace i

Heaven Sent Roofing is just that! Brian and his crew were amazing. On time, worked quickly, and the final result was Amazing! I would recommend them to anyone! This is a company that believes in taking care of the customer!

I was worried about damage to my roof. Heaven Sent came out and to check for damage. They were honest and told me that my roof was in good shape. This was absolutely not expected. It showed integrity and honesty, and I will absolutely use them in the future when needed and will refer them to anyone that asks. 5 stars!!!!

I enjoyed working with them.  They were very knowledgable and professional.  I am a contractor myself so it was nice to deal with a company that i did not feel i had to micro manage or look over their work.  They explained the estimate in great detail and did exactly what they proposed.  I would definitely recommend and use them again.

Incredibly honest, didn't try to push me into making any decisions. They performed a free roof inspection and did a minor repair without even charging me! If I ever need any roof work, I'll definitely be contacting them for all of our roofing needs!
Brian Griffin and his team did a tremendous job. On time, professional, courteous, superior quality work at the price quoted.
The work they did on our roof was professional, qality work!  They can be counted on to do a good job.
Best contractors I have ever worked with... They were always on time and everything was transparent. I would highly recommend them!
Inspected my roof free of charge and even fixed a few nails that had popped up
Excellent job in a timely manner. Highly recommended!!
